v[2]) + p[5] * abs(v[1] - v[3])","    if min(v[4:]) >= 0:","        score += p[6] * abs(v[5] - v[7])","    return score","def early(params, mem, frame, avail, info):","    p = params['settings']","    weights = params['colours']","    colours = [i for i in range(len(weights)) if weights[i] > 0]","    level = info.get('levels', 0)","    reset = info.get('resets', 0)","    if mem.get('level') != level or mem.get('reset') != reset:","        wins = mem.get('wins', {})","        if mem.get('level', level) < level and 'last' in mem:","            previous = mem['last'][1]","            wins[previous[0]] = wins.get(previous[0], 0) + 1","        mem.clear()","        mem.update({'level': level, 'reset': reset, 'wins': wins, 'pairs': {}, 'visits': {}, 'effects': {}, 'uses': {}, 'models': {}, 'edges': {}, 'streak': 0})","    objects = components(frame, colours)","    state = tuple(int(v) for v in frame[int(p[0]):, :].flatten())","    feature = features(objects, p)","    visits = mem['visits']","    visits[state] = visits.get(state, 0) + 1","    if 'last' in mem:","        old, action, before = mem['last']","        changed = old != state","        entry = mem['effects'].setdefault(action, [0, 0])","        entry[0] += int(changed)","        entry[1] += 1","        mem['edges'][(old, action)] = state","        if changed:","            delta = tuple(feature[i] - objective(feature, p))","        if 'last' in mem and action == mem['last'][1]:","            value -= p[20] / (1 + mem['streak'] / max(1.0, p[21]))","        value -= p[22] * mem['wins'].get(action[0], 0)","        choices.append((value, action))","    choices.sort(key=lambda item: (item[0], item[1]))","    action = choices[0][1]","    if 'last' in mem and action == mem['last'][1]:","        mem['streak'] += 1","    else:","        mem['streak'] = 0","    mem['pairs'][(state, action)] = mem['pairs'].get((state, action), 0) + 1","    mem['uses'][action] = mem['uses'].get(action, 0) + 1","    mem['last'] = (state, action, feature)","    if 6 in avail:","        return (6, action[1], action[2])","    return (avail[0], 0, 0)","def representation(frame, objects, q):","    agents = [o for o in objects if o[0] == int(q[1])]","    markers = [o for o in objects if o[0] == int(q[2])]","    if agents:","        agent = max(agents, key=lambda o: o[5])","        ax, ay = agent[6], agent[4] + q[6]","    else:","        ax, ay = -1.0, -1.0","    goals = [o for o in markers if abs(o[6] - height)","        height = y","        discount *= q[14]","    result += discount * q[15] * abs(gy - height)","    return result","def act(params, mem, frame, avail, info):","    q = params['planner']","    if info.get('levels', 0) < int(q[0]):","        return early(params, mem, frame, avail, info)","    weights = params['late_colours']","    level, reset = info.get('levels', 0), info.get('resets', 0)","    if mem.get('late_level') != level:","        mem.clear()","        mem.update({'late_level': level, 'reset': reset, 'models': {}, 'edges': {}, 'pairs': {}, 'visits': {}, 'effects': {}, 'nodes': {}, 'uses': {}, 'age': 0})","    if mem.get('reset') != reset:","        if 'last' in mem:","            a = mem['last'][1]","            e = mem['effects'].setdefault(a, [0, 0, 0])","            e[2] += 1","        mem['reset'] = reset","        mem.pop('last', None)","    objects = components(frame, [i for i in range(len(weights)) if weights[i] > 0])","    state = tuple(int(x) for x in frame[int(q[16]):, :].flatten())","    v = representation(frame, objects, q)","    visits = mem['visits']","    visits[state] = visits.get(state, 0) + 1","    if 'last' in mem:","        old, a, before = mem['last']","        mem['edges'].setdefault(old, {})[a] = state","        e = mem['effects'].setdefault(a, [0, 0, 0])","        e[1] += 1","        e[0] += int(old != state)","        if len(before) == len(v) and old != state:","            delta = tuple(v[i] - routecost(v, q))","        choices.append((value, a))","    choices.sort(key=lambda z: (z[0], z[1]))","    action = choices[0][1]","    if all(mem['pairs'].get((state, a), 0) > 0 for a in active):","        queue = [(state, None)]","        seen = {state}","        index = 0","        while index < len(queue) and index < int(q[32]):","            node, first = queue[index]","            index += 1","            if node != state and any(mem['pairs'].get((node, a), 0) == 0 for a in mem['nodes'].get(node, [])):","                if first in active:","                    action = first","                break","            for a, dest in mem['edges'].get(node, {}).items():","                if dest != node and dest not in seen:","                    seen.add(dest)","                    queue.append((dest, a if first is None else first))","    mem['pairs'][(state, action)] = mem['pairs'].get((state, action), 0) + 1","    mem['uses'][action] = mem['uses'].get(action, 0) + 1","    mem['last'] = (state, action, v)","    return (6 if 6 in avail else avail[0], action[1], action[2])"],"shapes":{"colours":[16],"settings":[23],"late_colours":[16],"planner":[33]},"params":{"colours":[0,0,0,0,0.3,0.2,0,0,0,4,0,0.4,0,0,0,0],"settings":[1,11,4,5,0.5,1,0.25,0.2,256,32,32,4,90,8,0.025,6,14,35,2,2,3,8,4],"late_colours":[0,0.6,0,0,0.4,0.3,0,0,0,4,0,0.7,0,0,0.5,0.5],"planner":[3,4,11,5,1,9,1,5,8,0.4,1,200,3,0.3,0.45,1.5,1,0.5,256,32,32,16,2,42,100,32,3,28,18,14,0.35,14,600]},"rationale":"Retains the credited early policy through three completed levels.
